problem: WXPAY_PRIVATE_KEY held the correct 3AF9 key material but CloudBase stored it as a single-line PEM with spaces instead of real LF. The runtime transform `replace(/\\n/g,'\n')` was a no-op on that string, so crypto.createSign threw ERR_OSSL_UNSUPPORTED inside jsapiOrder (before its try/catch) -> createOrder returned PAYMENT_ERROR (10009) with no order status update and no payment_logs row. Stage2_7 verification masked this because verify_binding.py normalized the PEM before parsing.

changes.CANONICAL_NORMALIZER: Upgraded `normalizePem` in paymentAuthority.js (the shared merchant/callback authority module) to a robust canonical normalizer: handles proper multiline, literal \\n, space-flattened, and CRLF PEM; preserves the label exactly; strips whitespace ONLY from the base64 body; re-wraps at 64 cols; returns trailing newline; FAIL-CLOSED on missing input / BEGIN-END label mismatch / malformed structure / non-base64 body (never coerces arbitrary text).
changes.PRIVATE_KEY_TYPE_GUARD: Added `normalizePrivateKeyPem(raw)`: normalizes then REQUIRES the label to be PRIVATE KEY / RSA PRIVATE KEY and crypto.createPrivateKey to succeed with asymmetricKeyType==='rsa'. PUBLIC KEY / CERTIFICATE / non-RSA / unparseable -> '' (fail-closed).
changes.FINGERPRINT_HELPER: Added `derivePrivateKeyFingerprint(pem)` = sha256 of the key's public SPKI (DER). Never touches/exposes the private scalar.
changes.SINGLE_RUNTIME_AUTHORITY: getConfig() in payment.js now reads WXPAY_PRIVATE_KEY (env or file) through normalizePrivateKeyPem(); the previous naive replace was removed so createOrder + verifyPayment share the exact same normalization+guard. paymentAuthority.js is byte-identical across createOrder/verifyPayment/payCallback; payment.js byte-identical across createOrder/verifyPayment.
changes.PRODUCTION_SELF_CHECK: Exported `selfCheckSigning(env)` from payment.js: raw env -> normalizePrivateKeyPem (authority) -> sign() (the SAME production signing helper) -> verify the signature with the key's own public half. Returns {ok, fingerprint, signatureLen, verified} + reason token; never prints the key. Exposed through createOrder.index and verifyPayment.index ONLY when event.__selfcheck===true (no order created, no payment, no entitlement, no DB write).
changes.REAL_SIGNING_GUARD: The self-check exercises the production sign() path (not a parallel signer), preventing another Stage2_7-style false positive.
changes.TESTS: tests/rc8.9/payment-pem-normalization.test.js (A-L, 29 assertions): multiline / literal-\n / space-flattened / CRLF PASS; PUBLIC KEY, CERTIFICATE, label-mismatch, invalid-base64, empty/missing FAIL CLOSED; authoritative fp anchor 624437be…; production sign verifies with own public half and NOT with a different key; live cloud-env shape normalizes.

rollbackPlan: git revert <this-commit>; redeploy createOrder/verifyPayment at prior commit. No env/DB changes involved.
